decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical shared command parser implementation.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
COMMAND TPARSE and BIOS SYSCONF include parse.asm; the separate psdata.inc remains an independently tracked dependency.

Re-ran verify_tparse_omf.py on the current parser and TPARSE: all 2840 object bytes covered, 2412 non-relocation bytes and 70 internal near branches match the inferred target; 428 relocation bytes await final linking.
Prior SYSCONF comparison also covers its selected parser expansion with remaining relocation and branch-layout differences described in review 037.
limitations: The target COMMAND module location is inferred and non-local relocations are not validated. Other parser configurations, final links and complete core binary identity remain unverified.
